sample_unit: endoscopists (man-machine comparison); dataset of 4482 images and 296 videos from 3279 patients

links.outcome: Endoscopist diagnostic accuracy with versus without AI assistance in multi-reader multi-case study
links.effect: With ENDOANGEL-ED's assistance, endoscopist accuracy significantly improved (70.61% vs. 79.63%, p < 0.001).
links.quote: With ENDOANGEL-ED's assistance, the accuracy of endoscopists significantly improved (70.61% vs. 79.63%, p < 0.001).

links.outcome: AI accuracy compared with 77 endoscopists on same videos
links.effect: ENDOANGEL-ED accuracy higher than all endoscopists in internal (81.10% vs. 70.61%, p<0.001) and external videos (88.24% vs. 78.49%, p<0.001).
links.quote: In man-machine comparison, the accuracy of ENDOANGEL-ED was significantly higher than that of all endoscopists in internal (81.10% vs. 70.61%, p < 0.001) and external videos (88.24% vs. 78.49%, p < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Incorporating domain knowledge into explainable AI design to increase clinician trust and acceptance compared with a traditional black-box deep learning model

screen.reason: The study evaluates an explainable AI system compared to standard 'black-box' deep learning in a reader study with 77 endoscopists, measuring the impact of explainability on clinician diagnostic performance, trust, and acceptance.
